objective: Auditar exclusivamente en solo lectura por qué HRLectura tiene permisos efectivos de escritura/DDL en EDARSAHUB y determinar si ya existe un principal canónico de migración. No cambiar permisos, no DDL, no DML, no leer secretos ni hashes de contraseña, no tocar Production.

queries.name: identity_and_effective_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE TABLE'),0) AS can_create_table,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo','SCHEMA','ALTER'),0) AS can_alter_dbo,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','OBJECT','INSERT'),0) AS can_insert_rbac,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','OBJECT','UPDATE'),0) AS can_update_rbac,COALESCE(HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos','OBJECT','INSERT'),0) AS can_insert_role_links

queries.name: hrlectura_database_roles
queries.sql: SELECT member_principal.name AS member_name,role_principal.name AS role_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals role_principal ON role_principal.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals member_principal ON member_principal.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE member_principal.name='HRLectura' ORDER BY role_principal.name

queries.name: hrlectura_explicit_database_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT pr.name AS principal_name,pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name,pe.class_desc,DB_NAME(pe.major_id) AS database_scope FROM sys.database_permissions pe JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON pr.principal_id=pe.grantee_principal_id WHERE pr.name='HRLectura' AND pe.class=0 ORDER BY pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name

queries.name: hrlectura_explicit_schema_object_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT pr.name AS principal_name,pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name,pe.class_desc,CASE WHEN pe.class=3 THEN SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS schema_name,CASE WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS object_name FROM sys.database_permissions pe JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON pr.principal_id=pe.grantee_principal_id WHERE pr.name='HRLectura' AND pe.class IN (1,3) ORDER BY pe.class_desc,schema_name,object_name,pe.permission_name

queries.name: candidate_migration_principals
queries.sql: SELECT name,type_desc,authentication_type_desc,default_schema_name,is_fixed_role FROM sys.database_principals WHERE type IN ('S','U','G') AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%migr%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%deploy%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%writer%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%escrit%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%ddl%') ORDER BY name

queries.name: candidate_migration_roles
queries.sql: SELECT name,type_desc,is_fixed_role FROM sys.database_principals WHERE type='R' AND (LOWER(name) LIKE '%migr%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%deploy%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%writer%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%escrit%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%ddl%') ORDER BY name

queries.name: fixed_role_members_for_hrlectura
queries.sql: SELECT rp.name AS role_name,mp.name AS member_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals rp ON rp.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals mp ON mp.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE mp.name='HRLectura' AND rp.is_fixed_role=1 ORDER BY rp.name

queries.name: server_role_membership_hrlectura
queries.sql: SELECT srp.name AS server_role,sp.name AS login_name FROM sys.server_role_members srm JOIN sys.server_principals srp ON srp.principal_id=srm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.server_principals sp ON sp.principal_id=srm.member_principal_id WHERE sp.name='HRLectura' ORDER BY srp.name
